title: Insights on back marking for the automated identification of animals
abstract: arXiv:2603.25535v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: To date, there is little research on how to design back marks to best support individual-level monitoring of uniform looking species like pigs. With the recent surge of machine learning-based monitoring solutions, there is a particular need for guidelines on the design of marks that can be effectively recognised by such algorithms. This study provides valuable insights on effective back mark design, based on the analysis of a machine learning model, trained to distinguish pigs via their back marks. Specifically, a neural network of type ResNet-50 was trained to classify ten pigs with unique back marks. The analysis of the model's predictions highlights the significance of certain design choices. Most importantly, the set of back marks must be designed such that each mark remains unambiguous under conditions of motion blur, diverse view angles and occlusions, caused by animal behaviour. translated_title: 关于动物自动识别中背部标记设计的见解
translated_abstract: 迄今为止，关于如何设计背部标记以最好地支持对猪等外观相似物种进行个体级别监测的研究很少。随着基于机器学习的监测解决方案的激增，特别需要关于如何设计能被此类算法有效识别的标记的指导方针。本研究通过分析一个训练用于通过背部标记区分猪的机器学习模型，为有效的背部标记设计提供了宝贵的见解。具体而言，研究者训练了一个ResNet-50类型的神经网络来对十头具有独特背部标记的猪进行分类。对模型预测的分析强调了某些设计选择的重要性。最重要的是，背部标记的设计必须确保每个标记在运动模糊、多样化视角以及由动物行为引起的遮挡条件下保持无歧义。所生成的见解可以支持个体级监测应用。
tldr: 本研究通过训练ResNet-50神经网络对猪的背部标记进行分类分析，揭示了标记设计的核心原则——标记必须在运动模糊、多视角和遮挡条件下保持清晰无歧义，从而为基于机器学习的动物个体自动识别提供设计指导。
en_tdlr: This study trains a ResNet-50 network to classify pigs by their back marks, revealing that marks must remain unambiguous under motion blur, diverse viewing angles, and occlusions to effectively support machine learning-based automated individual animal identification.
